review_ownership.p7c_evidence_strength: Legacy node evidence field; not a final semantic approval.
review_ownership.p7c_candidate_status: P7C candidate declaration only; not answer eligibility.
review_ownership.p7c_edge_derivation: P7C edge derivation declaration: explicit_text or llm_inference.
review_ownership.p7d_edge_review: Final edge-level pending/accepted/rejected status is stored separately under P7D using p7d_edge_review_schema_v1.json.
review_ownership.mutation_policy: P7D never writes review decisions back into p7_card.

notes: card_nature must be one of execution, assessment, risk_indicator, or control.
execution/control cards primarily support what-to-do paths; assessment/risk_indicator cards primarily support how-to-judge standards and scenario triggers.
summary is a short human-readable description only.
scenario, trigger, and objective are retrieval/readability aids, not required source-of-truth fields.
Formal triggers should be represented by trigger nodes in flow_nodes.
steps are human-readable aids derived from flow_nodes and flow_edges.

constraints: node_type must be one of flow_node_types.
A card may be a closed flow or an open local relation; do not invent an entry or exit only to close the graph.
E-prefix nodes are local entries of the current card.
X-prefix nodes are local exits, stable results, or handoff points of the current card.
edge_type must be one of PRECEDES, REFERENCES, PRODUCES, DECIDES, FEEDBACK.
derivation must be explicit_text or llm_inference for current P7C output.
REFERENCES means a process node points to a non-sequential auxiliary input, clue, standard, judgement dimension, or component.
relation_type 若填写，必须为 relation_types 中的值，用于补充 edge_type 无法表达的语义关系。
source and target must reference node_id values in the same card.
BRIDGES_TO is not allowed inside p7_card.flow_edges.
bridge_edges connect card to card, or a card output to another card trigger.
bridge_edges are not stored in p7_card.flow_edges.

validation_rules: Every p7_card must include the minimal required fields.
flow_nodes and flow_edges are the formal process graph and the source of truth.
Every flow_node and flow_edge must include evidence_unit_ids and evidence_strength.
Every evidence_unit_ids value must exist in the P6 base graph.
flow_edges source and target must point to node_id values inside the same card.
REFERENCES targets should be input or standard nodes.
PRODUCES targets should be X-prefix exit nodes.
BRIDGES_TO must be represented as p7_bridge_edge, not as p7_card.flow_edges.
P5 alias may normalize terms, but cannot be used as edge evidence.
Derived indexes and render views are not knowledge source-of-truth objects.
